update.title: OT-97.71: Isaiah 57:18-21 and 1 Samuel 16:6 woven (#2160)
update.strand: open threads on completed clusters (#2160), OT-97.71 (M47)
update.researcher_instruction: "Add Isa 57:18-19, Isa 57:20-21 and 1Sa 16:6 as proposed with their claims, close OT-97.71, commit and push, then read OT-97.17 (M09)." (2026-10-18)
update.method: OT-97.71 (the M08 marks on Isa 57:15 and 1Sa 16:7) read in their passages (Isa 57:13-21; 1Sa 16:1-13). Both verses were already told for their M47 words. Three passage gaps woven: Isa 57:18-19 in 10.9 When God hides his face (after 57:17); Isa 57:20-21 in Ch 12 False peace (the Ch 12 option of the two proposed); 1Sa 16:6 in Ch 4 The heart is hidden, and God sees it (with 16:7). Rule 77: no claim is told in the three touched passages; none untold on these concepts.
update.claims_changed_note: Three new claims: healing promised after the heart's way is seen; the tossing sea as the inner state of the wicked (I read); the prophet's thought formed from appearance and corrected.

new.text: God's seeing of a heart's own backsliding way is followed by a promise to heal, not by giving it up
new.beyond_text: joins 57:18-19 to the heart of 57:17 that did not notice the hidden face

new.text: The tossing sea that cannot be quiet pictures the inner state of the wicked: no stillness, what is thrown up is mire, and by God's word no peace
new.beyond_text: reads the figure of Isa 57:20 as an inner state, and sets it against a false peace and beside the arrogant man never at rest

new.text: Even the prophet sent to choose formed his thought from appearance, and God's word corrected it
new.beyond_text: sets Samuel's thought (16:6) as what 16:7 answers

tellings.passage: The same hidden face is not met the same way by every heart
tellings.part: A heart that does not notice (Isaiah 57:17-19)

tellings.passage: The heart can say that all is well
